work_title: Support n-ary functions in ErgoScript via NAryFunctionLowering
description: Added NAryFunctionLowering compiler phase lowering n-ary lambdas and applications into right-nested pairs, with unit and cross-version tests in NAryFunctionLoweringTest, SigmaCompilerTest, and BasicOpsSpecification (https://github.com/ergoplatform/sigmastate-interpreter/pull/1198).
